title: Weather station
description: Readings from the ingest service's SQLite database (docs/database.md). Times are the station's NTP clock, or the server's receive time when the station was unsynced.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) AS time, temp_c AS "Temperature" FROM readings WHERE unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) AS time, temp_c AS "Temperature" FROM readings WHERE unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Minutes between readings (5 = on cadence; spikes are gaps)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, (time - lag(time) OVER (ORDER BY time)) / 60.0 AS "Interval" FROM (SELECT unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) AS time FROM readings WHERE unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000) ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT time, (time - lag(time) OVER (ORDER BY time)) / 60.0 AS "Interval" FROM (SELECT unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) AS time FROM readings WHERE unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Time since the previous stored reading. A steady 5 means none are missing; a spike of N means about N/5 - 1 readings were lost.

panels.title: Latest readings
panels.description: Raw rows, newest first, for checking chart points against the database.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT id, reading_id, device_time, received_at, temp_c, rh_pct, press_hpa, wind_avg_kmh, wind_peak_kmh, wind_dir_deg, rain_mm, bme280, rssi_dbm FROM readings WHERE unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 ORDER BY unixepoch(COALESCE(device_time, received_at)) DESC LIMIT 50
